cohort_revision.supersedes: the earlier full Micro24 P3 cohort only
cohort_revision.selection: within each frozen parent stratum, SHA256('P3_LDS_MICRO12_V1:' + output_id) ascending, first three

development_context.allowed_use_of_gold: hypothesis-class selection only; no task-specific thresholds or LDS parameter fitting
development_context.observed_reason_for_test: 90/144 canonical d24 miss cells retained the Gold successor without expanding it; HIGH group 38/48

policy.label: P3
policy.name: LDS_UNIT_DISCREPANCY_V1
policy.principle: duplicate-free discrepancy-layered depth-first ordering over the frozen retained work set

discrepancy_increment.rank_reference: full legal ARC-token ranking from model logits before retention
discrepancy_increment.frontier_floor_rule: use original model local_token_rank, not frontier-floor restore rank

policy.path_discrepancy: sum of unit discrepancy increments over the non-EOS prefix
selection_rule: choose the smallest discrepancy_count with pending retained work
within that discrepancy layer use LIFO depth-first traversal
for siblings entering the same layer, preserve historical local ordering by cumulative_nll ascending, then insertion_order, then work_item_id
policy.cumulative_regret_use: retention/pruning only; not a P3 traversal priority
